convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, pen interactive Export scale 2 (default) vs Playwright deviceScaleFactor-2 captures of the NORMALIZED v003 standalone clipped at the rounded capture-root rect. Chromium 140.0.7339.16 headless-shell (playwright 1.55.0) launched with --disable-lcd-text --force-color-profile=srgb --font-render-hinting=none. Protocol carried from the v002 lock: reducedMotion:reduce, animation/transition freeze CSS, document.fonts.ready, states.json step drive, pointer parked at 0,0 (pointer-engaged states keep the pointer - prices-datepicker-years stays on .ui-dp-head .m per the v002-amend2 recipe), EMPTY localStorage per state (fresh context), transform-free rounded-clip roots. L3a ORDERING (ENG-4784, this round): >=1000ms settle after the last interaction step, then the state textProbes read on the live DOM (a miss re-drives, 3-attempt cap), then the 2500ms deferred-timer settle, then the shot with a two-consecutive-shots byte-identity gate; prices-datepicker-years additionally asserts the owner-ruled year-grid probe (24 cells 2003-2026, 2003-2015 disabled) before AND after the settle. Probes read BEFORE the deferred settle because the r86 deeplink highlight is a 1800ms timed class: behavior truth at probe time, post-timer rest state in the pixel frame (the v002 locked truth - the wash is not in the v002 frame either). Per-target sha256 distinctness enforced across all 30 states (no pixelIdenticalTo declared; none needed).
convergence.determinism: double-export verified at the committed path: all 30 frame exports byte-identical across two pen interactive sessions at @pen.dev/cli 0.3.5 (Linux; sharp-encoded PNG; per-frame sha256 in perState). Full-set target re-render also byte-reproducible (identical target sha256 across independent runs). CROSS-MACHINE CAVEAT RESOLVED THIS ROUND: an initial export of the v002 lock differed from the locked exportSha256 values ONLY because the hemlock chart-categorical palette moved under the role bindings (design-specs commit 9e5e490, palette v5) - rasterization itself reproduced the v002 lock byte-for-byte in every non-series region. The lab re-export MUST resolve the hemlock library at or after commit 9e5e490.
convergence.authoringMethod: Re-oracle at prototype v003 seeded from the v002 lock (the recorded normalization recipe + the 28 locked frames as the authoring base). Document-level: the five derived chart-palette local-token families (chart-series-label = series RGB x 0.62, chart-bubble-fill +1F, chart-bubble-stroke +2E, chart-series-fade +52/+05; light AND dark) recomputed from the CURRENT library palette (v5, commit 9e5e490) by the recorded v002 derivation rules. Carried frames spliced per the r98 furniture relocations, every position from measured DOM of the normalized v003 standalone: prices pages (14 frames) - foot as-of words deleted, nav pill cluster translated into the foot controls row, head stamp emitted ($control-text-faint / $y:text-size-xs), sp-page-foot removed, frames resized; secdata pages (3) - ditto plus the actions cluster re-anchored (the hidden .sp-sd-foot row deleted); comparison pages (4) - per-cluster measured deltas (dates +15.5 / slider +11.5 / plot +12 incl. geometry-string translation of svg paths / facades +11.75 / entry hint -37.59 / entry -40.75), the r92 under-grid hint deleted, the single r98 foot rebuilt (nav-first, right-aligned stamp), the How button added ($y:sem-btnPrimaryBg pill + $y:sem-btnPrimaryText 14/600 words); prices-narrow - nav wrap-first foot + segment cluster +10.5; items dialogs (3) - interior rebuilt from measured DOM (r97 sel_list_intro sub-line, r96 Performance badge 11, retired spSecPerf:3 menu item absent), head chrome carried verbatim. NEW frames authored from measured DOM: secdata-revenue-growth-row (Company Financials expanded, spSecFin:1 .is-on.is-added, item-added chrome idioms) and comparison-explainer-open (title / red na line / intro / THE CHART / THE TEN CHARACTERISTICS with 10 UA-disc-marker list items - marker idiom carried from the v002 crypto-notes: 4x4 rounded rect, x = liTextStart - 15). Text emission rule (re-calibrated this round, 14 combos, two-rasterizer glyph-top scan): pen text at lineHeight 1, y = wordRangeTop + (rangeH - fontSize)/2, x = fractional DOM word x; the 14px combos carry a +0.5 correction (measured o=4 vs rule 3.5). textTransform applied at emission (uppercase captions).

normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: No family substitution required - the prototype already leads with Heebo (--font-ui) and Noto Serif (--font-serif). Serving source pinned: the Google Fonts stylesheet links are replaced by @font-face rules for the SAME repo TTFs the .pen embeds (pencil/designs/fonts/). Plus: .btn-primary, .segmented button, input, textarea, select gain font-family var(--font-ui) !important - these controls set no font-family and render UA Arial (prototype defect DC-2, carried from v001).
normalizationRecipe.notes: REPLAY MECHANICS: the injected <style> block must land at the LAST </body> occurrence (the prototype embeds an earlier </body> inside a JS string; v001 finding, still true at r95). The v001 UA-chrome dialog-button injections are RETIRED - the custom-axis dialog they patched was deleted at r82/P1-8; no UA-chrome button surface renders in the v002 contracted states. Range-slider synthesis (capture-side, not a prototype edit): the r92 .sf-range rules - track 3px accent pill full width, thumb 22px accent circle with 2px surface ring and 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.35) shadow - are drawn from the stylesheet because Chrome cannot resolve -webkit-slider-* pseudo styles through getComputedStyle. UA list markers (crypto-notes bullets): disc d=round(fontSize/3), right edge 11px before the li text start, top = baseline - d - 2 (measured against the rendered target). Unrendered-in-contracted-states variables injected for kit coherence but never measured: --seq*, --pos-mid, --pos-soft/--neg-soft, --accent-fill, --crosshair-stroke (legacy), --taupe-hover (hover-only), --panel-shadow/--tile-shadow (unrendered at r95 in contracted states), --hairline, --orange, --charcoal, --gauge-*, --cat1..15 (undashed template set), --hero-*, --accent-2/3/4, --sc-modal-* (kernel constants). V003 DELTAS: the ten --cat-N injected values re-resolved against the CURRENT hemlock library (chart-categorical palette v5, design-specs commit 9e5e490 - the library moved under the role bindings after the v002 lock; every other recipe value re-verified unchanged against the current library). The color:#6A707E findReplace now covers FOUR occurrences (the r98 card-head stamp .sp-head-asof hardcodes the same literal the v002 round unified to $control-text-faint - design-rules rule 53 anticipated exactly this). All 85 cssVariableInjections re-verified present in the r98 :root blocks with unchanged from-values; the three findReplace targets re-verified present.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: series color assignment (chart lines, KPI swatches/top bars, edge value pills, comparison bubbles, detail chart, tooltip swatches)
tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: $chart-categorical/color-01..10 in SERIES ORDER (v002 defaults are SEVEN: SPY->01, QQQ->02, NVDA->03, AAPL->04, GOOGL->05, MSFT->06, META->07; BTC single-set rides color-01)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Chart-series roles bind by series order to the palette priority order, never by hue-matching (token rule 3; GC-004/v001 precedent). Position-indexed assignment question stays with designer review (v001 flags DJ-002 carried).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: secondary/nested surfaces (--surface-2, --nest #F8F7F6)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Resting secondary-surface role. NOTE (carried): GC-004 bound the same raw value to $sem-background-hover - same resolved value, two role names; flag for designer unification.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: strong borders (--border-strong #B9B5AE; late :root --tk-border-strong #A8A8A8; kit #D4D4D4) + the table row-scrubber handle fill (background:var(--border-strong))
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: One strong-border role; values shift token-true (v001 precedent). The row-scrubber handle FILL rides the same variable coupling the prototype declares - $sem-scrollbarThumb is the designer-likely role; flagged rather than silently remapped.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: default widget borders (--tk-border #E5E5E5 / late :root #CFCFCF) and chart gridlines (--grid/--grid2 #C8CAC9; .sf-grid stroke #DCDDDC hardcoded)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Default border + gridline roles (GC-004/v001 precedent; no chart-gridline role exists).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: axis labels/stems/zero line (--axis/--zero #6E7270, --det #5E5954)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Axis text role; the prototype couples stems/zero to the same variable, so coupled surfaces ride the same role (v001 precedent).
Role ladder by prominence; values shift token-true to the Hemlock ink ladder (v001 precedent).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: intent washes (--tk-error #B91C1C, --tk-error-subtle/--neg-subtle #FEE2E2, --pos-subtle #DCFCE7)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Intent roles; values shift to the Hemlock intent washes (v001 precedent).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: KPI tile hairline border
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Taupe hairline-on-surface role; nearest role token to Bill's tuned value (v001 precedent).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: r92 comparison date slider (track full-width fill + 22px thumb)

tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: track + thumb $y:sem-sliderAccent; thumb ring $y:sem-background-surface; thumb shadow $sp-sliderThumbShadow (new gap)

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: picks-table header-cell bottom hairline
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The th hairline rides the accent-subtle variable coupling in the prototype; bound to the highlight wash role that owns that value. A border-category role for the accent wash does not exist - designer may prefer one.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: r82 kernel foot stamps (.sp-asof-foot, .sp-md-note, page-foot disclaimeresque)

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: selected pick-indicator fill (Data-items dialog, .is-added::before)

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: shadows (typeahead/datepicker dd 0 4 12 @.12, dialogs 0 16 40 @.16, segments 0 1 2 @.05, fmt dialog 0 18 48 @.20, sticky-column fade, slider thumb)

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: detail-modal chart area fade
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: GC-004/v001 fade idiom carried; BTC modal rides color-01.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: update/dialog action buttons, dp selected day, foot-nav + More-Detail outline pills, download/format actions
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: var(--tk-btn-accent)/#3A6AF8 fills, accent borders, accent link text
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Accent surfaces bound per role category, not per hue (v001 precedent).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: chart palette re-derivation at v003 (series lines, KPI swatches/top bars, edge pills, bubbles, fades, labels)
